testedVersions: .NET 11; Microsoft Graph REST v1.0 synthetic HTTP fixtures only
prerequisites: Organization.Read.All application consent for tenant verification
TeamMember.Read.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All and Sites.Read.All application consent for the selected child sections
limits: Public Graph cloud only; no live tenant validation
At most 20000 teams per section; full paged reads, no delta
Metadata only: no messages, chat content, files, recordings, phone numbers or effective access
Chat and telephony scope are consultant Assessments, not collection evidence

sections.refreshStrategy: Full paged snapshot of team identity and basic metadata
limits: The team ID equals its Microsoft 365 group ID, but team and group remain distinct object types
No archive state or settings: list teams does not populate those fields
Group references stay pending until collected in the same environment

sections.refreshStrategy: Page memberships independently per team, preserving successful parents and pages on failures
limits: Opaque membership IDs are prefixed with their team ID, never parsed
Owners are memberships whose roles contain owner; direct team membership does not prove channel or site access
Foreign or missing tenant/user IDs remain separate evidence, never resolved to a local user by name or email
No private/shared channel membership expansion; tenant-wide application consent, not resource-specific consent

sections.refreshStrategy: Full paged read of channels hosted by each team
limits: Standard, private and shared channel types are preserved
Incoming shared channels hosted by other teams or tenants are not enumerated
No messages, tabs, email addresses or channel membership; unknown types make coverage partial

sections.refreshStrategy: Resolve each group root and channel filesFolder independently; inspect driveItem metadata only when filesFolder lacks a site collection ID
limits: Sites.Read.All also authorizes filesFolder and driveItem metadata; Files.Read.All alone does not cover group root sites
filesFolder supports no query options; raw response, download URLs and content are discarded
Same site collection GUID reuses site/sharepoint.siteId across producers; different private/shared site IDs remain distinct
URLs are dated alternative evidence, not automatic merge keys; URL-only identities remain provisional
Unreadable/unprovisioned sites leave endpoint references to verify; no fallback to team root, no URL guessing
Access tests sample one team and one channel, not every private/shared channel
